title: Publish Preview
summary: Previews what npm publish will ship from npm pack --dry-run and flags .env files, source maps, tests and missing build output before it goes out.
description: npm publish preview from `npm pack --dry-run --json` that flags .env files and keys, source maps, tests, repo config, large files, entry points missing from the build, an already-published version, private: true and no files allowlist, with fixes.
catches: .env files and keys in the tarball
Source maps, tests and repo config shipped by accident
Entry points missing from the build, with the reason (.gitignore fallback, files list, no build)
Version already published, with a next version
private: true, or no files allowlist
limits: Needs the pack output and package.json you pass; it doesn't run npm
A fix only counts after a fresh pack
Doesn't check the package's runtime behaviour
a11y: File list is a labelled section; the issue list is focusable
Fix buttons are real buttons; waiting state has text
server: Run npm pack checks in CI with a files allowlist and provenance before publishing.
